facts.fact: 仓库堆满破旧工作服、磨花防护靴、积尘头盔面罩——氧化汗味加铁味令人窒息
facts.anchor: The smell of oxidized male sweat and iron was stifling

facts.fact: Miu 抱怨总务部替大老爷们收拾烂摊子：Fujii 从不做这种事，扬言要告公司性别歧视
facts.anchor: I’m going to sue the company for gender discrimination

facts.fact: 炸弹：Miu 宣布公司要让她做工会账目——Yuko 失手掉落头盔，空响回荡
facts.anchor: They’re trying to make me do union accounting

facts.fact: 九年来从没人叫她交出工会会计之位；她怀疑是 Ushio 放的谣言
facts.anchor: For nine years, I had never been told to give up my position as the union accountant

facts.fact: 危机推演：她多次取款（一半私藏一半回柜已补足），账本存折只有她经手——Miu 一对账就露馅
facts.anchor: If she looked closely at the passbooks or the ledger, she would realize that something was off

facts.fact: 沾油黑手套散发锈铁味——恶心如鼻血旧疾发作，她捂住口鼻只想逃离此屋
facts.anchor: I began to feel nauseated, the way I used to when I got nosebleeds

facts.fact: Miu 的狗宣言：我信狗——不像男人那样背叛我，没开口就懂我；她温柔接过 Yuko 打死的绳结解开
facts.anchor: They don’t betray me like men do, and they understand me before I’ve even said a word
